content.instructions: “gern” after the verb says you like doing something. “nicht gern” says you do not. For a preference use “lieber”, and for the thing you like most use “am liebsten”. “gern”, “nicht gern” and “lieber” come after the verb. “am liebsten” usually does too, but it can also start the sentence, with the verb straight after it: “Am liebsten gehe ich wandern.”
text:
Likes and preferences
MeaningListenGerman
I like itIch schwimme gern.
I do not like itIch spiele nicht gern Fußball.
I prefer itIch lese lieber.
I like it bestIch tanze am liebsten.
Ich koche gern. Ich lese lieber. Am liebsten gehe ich wandern.
